title: AISIM
terms-intro-content: Please read the following User Terms carefully before using our services. These terms constitute a legal agreement between you and AISIM.
terms-acceptance-content: By accessing or using AISIM's Services, you agree to be bound by these User Terms. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use our Services.
terms-services-content: AISIM offers online purchase and activation of eSIM cards. We are committed to providing users with convenient global connectivity solutions. Our services include, but are not limited to, eSIM card sales, activation support, and customer service.
terms-user-responsibility-content: You agree to comply with all applicable laws and regulations when using our Services and not to engage in any illegal or improper activity. It is your responsibility to ensure that your device is compatible and supports eSIM features.
terms-privacy-content: Please refer to our Privacy Policy for information on how we collect, use, and disclose your personal information.
terms-risks-content: You acknowledge the risks of using an Internet-based system, including hardware and software failures, malicious software, and unauthorized access.
terms-liability-content: AISIM is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, including loss of data or revenue.
terms-amendments-content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Use at any time with at least 30 days' notice.
terms-warranty-content: The services are provided 'as is' without any warranties.
terms-contact-content: If you have any questions, please contact us at support@AISIM.com.
privacy-intro-content: At AISIM, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy-collection-content: We collect information you provide to us directly, such as when you create an account, purchase an eSIM, or contact our support team. We also collect certain information automatically, including your device information, IP address, and usage data.
privacy-use-content: We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process your transactions, communicate with you, and ensure the security of our services.
privacy-sharing-content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processors, and as required by law.
privacy-security-content: We implement a variety of security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.
privacy-amendments-content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make changes, we will notify you by revising the date at the top of the policy and, in some cases, provide additional notice.
privacy-contact-content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@AISIM.com.
